abilities.knowledgeBasesHint: Select knowledge bases the agent can access

model.providerHint: Select the language model provider for the agent
model.temperatureHint: Control output randomness, 0 for deterministic, 1 for maximum randomness
model.maxTokensHint: Limit the maximum number of tokens per response
model.topPHint: Control output diversity, 0.1 means only considering the top 10% probability tokens

advanced.planningHint: Let the agent automatically plan task steps
advanced.maxMessagesHint: Maximum number of messages to retain in memory
advanced.maxRetriesHint: Maximum retry attempts on task failure

reset.title: Reset Agent
reset.confirm: Are you sure you want to reset {name} to its initial state?
reset.warning: After reset, the agent's soul and tool configuration will be restored to system defaults. Your custom modifications will be lost.
